shape.text: A personal access token is xapt- followed by a lowercase-hex UUID, 41 characters in all. The documentation says it starts with xapt-; the Go SDK checks that prefix at runtime, and its test values use the same UUID layout for both token kinds.

issuance.text: The token is used with an organization id: AXIOM_TOKEN together with AXIOM_ORG_ID, or an Authorization: Bearer header with the x-axiom-org-id header.
A personal access token carries the user's full console and API access, including queries over every ingested log.
